profile.headline: Software Engineer specializing in AI Platforms

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.insights: Skills: System Architecture · Go (Programming Language) · Python · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked with an awesome team of people developing and supporting our two consumer lending software products, EnCompass and KwikLoan. Some of my responsibilities included: 

Developed and tested new functionality to existing software which in most cases was customized to our clients' specific needs.
Supported our codebase by solving support tickets from our clients entered through Zendesk (web-based ticket management system).  
was responsible for development and programming of financial forms (such as monthly statements and credit applications) and the modification of existing ones according to client specifications.

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
Provided technical support for a complex medical claim adjudication application running on IBM i (AS/400) for Pharmacy Benefits Management client.
Analyzed customer requests to create custom reports by running queries and extracting data from IBM i DB2 database.
Responsible for updating ticket status journal on a daily basis and contacting users on client side on progress status.

positions.title: President
positions.description:
* Searched for prospect guest speakers and invite them to share their knowledge with our members in monthly meetings.
* Notified members via e-mail and the organization's website about upcoming meetings and job opportunities.
* Planed and conducted meetings.
* Maintained and updated records of all members and visitors of the chapter.
* Updated the organization's website on a regular basis.
* Worked with other chapter officers on goal setting and accomplishment.

company.name: Association of IT Professionals - Gwinnett Tech Chapter

positions.title: Commercial Insulation / Piping Estimator
positions.description:
* Estimated costs for installation of HVAC mechanical piping and insulation for commercial construction projects on a daily basis.
* Worked closely with the Supervisor of Insulation department to design and constantly improve complex spreadsheets that aided in accurately calculating costs for materials and labor of commercial projects.
* Assisted supervisors and project managers in the preparation of construction submittals on a daily basis.

positions.title: Office Manager
positions.description:
• Managed all medical billing in the practice.
• Supervised and assisted office employees in daily duties.
• Trained and assisted office employees in the use of Medical Software and the Microsoft Office Suite.
